method: Deterministic bespoke hard-surface reconstruction; interpreted external dimensions and openings, not a measured survey. Reference images are not redistributed.

references.use: West range: four octagonal ogee-capped turrets, hall tracery, oriel and Cosin porch.
North range: upper hall behind low Tunstall Gallery, polygonal clock stair and chapel.
Keep: irregular octagonal plan, corner buttresses, high plinth, mixed mullioned windows and retaining walls.
Gatehouse: open round arch, flanking projections, rose window and battlements.
